Leah (Billing): Invoice 104501 failed - card declined with code FRAUD_SUSPECT. Customer says bank flagged unusual high-amount purchase. They offered to pay part now by card and do overnight ACH for remainder. Need ACH routing for USD and guidance on handling suspected-fraud declines.
Omar (Sales): Customer is PulseData. They can cover $2,000 by card immediately, remainder $18,500 by ACH today. Can we accept ACH same-day? Any docs needed?
Kai (Support): Auth log shows decline: FRAUD_SUSPECT + issuer_contact_required. Payments team recommends do not retry card; ask customer to confirm with bank and provide a written authorization for split payment.
ops-payments-bot: Logged payment fail PAY-104501. Auto-retry scheduled in 48h.
Leah (Billing): Please cancel auto-retry; we'll coordinate split. @ops-billing cancel retries and open ACH request WR-1045.
ops-billing: Auto-retry cancelled. ACH request WR-1045 created. Please use ops-payments-secure to collect signed split-payment consent.
Omar (Sales): Sharing secure link with customer now. Also can we provide our US ACH details?
Leah (Billing): ACH (USD): Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc. Account: 987654321 Routing (ABA): 026009593 Reference: INV-104501 / PulseData PO-990. Note: include remitter company name and bank confirmation for same-day credit.
Kai (Support): Once ACH hits, apply $18,500 and mark invoice paid. If card posts first for $2,000, reconcile partial payment and then clear with ACH.
Omar (Sales): Customer confirmed they'll send authorization and ACH transfer tonight.
Leah (Billing): Great. Keep thread posted when confirmation or bank trace arrives. We'll close WR-1045 after reconciliation.
